Owner: Vince. Enforcement: preflight-invocable audit script + runbook docs/runbooks/graph-least-privilege.md.
appRegistration: PLX Mission Control Sync (7c73cbc9; app-only; MICROSOFT_GRAPH_CLIENT_ID)

siteGrants.$comment: Granted per-site via POST /sites/{siteId}/permissions once Sites.Selected replaces the broad role.

MC evidence store: mc_upload_evidence writes to the "Mission Control" library on PLXSite (src/lib/compliance/evidence-artifacts.ts). Granted per-site by Azure admin 2026-10-26; MC never creates the library or grants access.

transitionalRoles.$comment: Broad legacy role the sync engine and the evidence store run on. retireBy has passed and is not extended: Vince decided on 2026-11-01 to keep the role as an accepted exception (see acceptedExceptions), so the audit warns on it until that record's reviewBy and fails after. Removal plan, if the decision changes: docs/runbooks/graph-least-privilege.md (PLXSite section).

acceptedExceptions.reason: Decision as answered in MC: "Keep Sites.ReadWrite.All; record it as an accepted exception." The sync engine and the evidence store keep running on the broad role.
acceptedExceptions.$comment: A person's decision to keep a transitional role past its retireBy. The audit allows the role until reviewBy, then fails again; renew with a new decision or remove the role.
